correctness.rationale: The source equations were reconstructed at the disease-free equilibrium. Only susceptible/diabetic-to-exposed incidence creates new infected individuals; progression from the exposed state into later infected states is transfer. The resulting next-generation matrix is rank one with the stated spectral radius. The full local-stability threshold follows because the infected block is Metzler, its real characteristic equation is strictly increasing at the spectral bound, its sign at zero is the sign of one minus the corrected reproduction number, and the disease-free demographic block has strictly negative eigenvalues. Exact rational replay checks the two-strain witness and its positive eigenvalue factor.

value.rationale: The correction changes a model-selection quantity used directly in a published local-stability theorem. For one strain the printed and corrected quantities cross one together, so the defect is easy to miss; with multiple branches the shared exposed class makes contributions additive, creating a genuine false-stability region. The explicit two-strain witness demonstrates a qualitative reversal, not a cosmetic normalization difference.
